test_read_dataset: test HuggingFaceDatasetReader to read a Hugging Face dataset by name and extract text from a specified key
test_read_streaming_dataset: test HuggingFaceDatasetReader to stream a Hugging Face dataset without downloading it locally
test_read_dataset_shuffle: test HuggingFaceDatasetReader with shuffle_files enabled to randomize file order during iteration
test_read_streaming_dataset_shuffle: test HuggingFaceDatasetReader with both streaming and shuffle_files enabled for randomized streaming reads
test_sharding: test HuggingFaceDatasetReader with rank and world_size parameters to shard dataset across multiple processes
